description: This file defines the interface for a JSON writer library in C, including data structures and function prototypes for constructing JSON objects and arrays in a buffer. It is meant for building JSON strings programmatically, with support for nested structures, various data types, and formatting options.

methods.name: jw_init
methods.description: Initializes a json_writer instance with empty buffers.

methods.name: jw_release
methods.description: Releases internal buffers and cleans up the json_writer.

methods.name: jw_object_begin
methods.description: Starts a JSON object as the top-level structure, with optional pretty formatting.

methods.name: jw_array_begin
methods.description: Starts a JSON array as the top-level structure, with optional pretty formatting.

methods.name: jw_object_string
methods.description: Adds a string key-value pair to the current JSON object.

methods.name: jw_object_intmax
methods.description: Adds an integer value with a given key to the current JSON object.

methods.name: jw_object_double
methods.description: Adds a double-precision floating point number as a value for a key in the current object, with specified precision.

methods.name: jw_object_true
methods.description: Adds a boolean true field with the specified key to the current object.

methods.name: jw_object_false
methods.description: Adds a boolean false field with the specified key to the current object.

methods.name: jw_object_bool
methods.description: Adds a boolean field (true or false) with the specified key to the current object.

methods.name: jw_object_null
methods.description: Adds a null value field with the specified key to the current object.

methods.name: jw_object_sub_jw
methods.description: Embeds another json_writer object as a field value within the current object.

methods.name: jw_object_inline_begin_object
methods.description: Begins an inline nested object as a value of a specified key within the current object.

methods.name: jw_object_inline_begin_array
methods.description: Begins an inline array as a value of a specified key within the current object.

methods.name: jw_array_string
methods.description: Appends a string value to the current array.

methods.name: jw_array_intmax
methods.description: Appends an integer value to the current array.

methods.name: jw_array_double
methods.description: Appends a double value to the current array with specified precision.

methods.name: jw_array_true
methods.description: Appends a boolean true value to the current array.

methods.name: jw_array_false
methods.description: Appends a boolean false value to the current array.

methods.name: jw_array_bool
methods.description: Appends a boolean value to the current array.

methods.name: jw_array_null
methods.description: Appends a null value to the current array.

methods.name: jw_array_sub_jw
methods.description: Embeds another json_writer object as a value in the current array.

methods.name: jw_array_argc_argv
methods.description: Appends a specified number of strings from argc/argv to the current array.

methods.name: jw_array_argv
methods.description: Appends a null-terminated array of strings to the current array.

methods.name: jw_array_inline_begin_object
methods.description: Starts an inline object as a value in the current array.

methods.name: jw_array_inline_begin_array
methods.description: Starts an inline array as a value in the current array.

methods.name: jw_is_terminated
methods.description: Checks if all open objects and arrays have been properly closed.

methods.name: jw_end
methods.description: Closes the current open object or array, adding the appropriate closing character.
